answer: We need answer only text, 600 char limit counting spaces, target 340-470. Two to four sentences. No lists/headings. Need one concrete mechanism for agent economy resist sybil attacks, framed as mechanism prices coordination itself. Must naturally include nadir, willow, island each different sentence, not list together, not open with all three. Must name mechanism in 3-6 plain words, explain enforcement rule and concrete per-identity cost attacker pays. Avoid templates: bonded stake, burn-to-register, quadratic fees, vouching trellis, staked identity registry, proof of personhood.
